versions.content: The Crypto Stack shall provide interfaces to use symmetric key wrapping primitives Status: DRAFT Description: The Crypto Stack shall support symmetric authenticated encrypting/decrypting or wrapping/unwrapping of key values unavailable for applications in a plain form. Rationale: Secure keys transportation. Dependencies: RS_CRYPTO_02001, RS_CRYPTO_02002 Use Case: Export/Import of key material. Supporting Material: –
